data.text:
Barangay Greater Lagro
June 20, 2025

To:
The Honorable Speaker Martin Romualdez
@SpeakerMartinPH
House of Representatives
Batasan Complex, Quezon City

Subject: Request for Transparency and Public Accounting of Vice President Sara Duterte’s Foreign Travels

Dear Speaker Romualdez,

I am writing as a concerned citizen to call for a full and public accounting of all foreign trips undertaken—and those still being planned—by Vice President Sara Duterte during her tenure.

Recent travels abroad by the Vice President, particularly when they coincide with critical events at home such as natural disasters or major national developments, have raised serious questions. The public deserves clear and credible answers. Specifically, we seek:
1.A detailed explanation of the purpose and objectives of each trip.
https://t.co/xk2s3NTQd7 these trips relate to her official responsibilities as Vice President and any concurrent roles she may hold.
3.Documentation of engagements abroad—such as official meetings, forums, or agreements—and how these are intended to benefit the Filipino people.
4.Any evaluations or feedback on the value or effectiveness of these trips.
5.Tangible, measurable outcomes that justify the cost and effort—whether in aid, partnerships, programs, or other public gains.
6.A compelling justification for why public funds are repeatedly being spent on trips that, from the public’s perspective, yield no visible or meaningful benefit.

Alongside this, we also request a complete breakdown of the government funds spent on these travels, including:
•Travel and accommodation costs
•Per diems and allowances
•Staff and security expenses
•Use of confidential, intelligence, or discretionary funds

It is not sufficient to simply label these as “personal” or “long-scheduled” trips, especially when they are taken at times when national leadership and presence are most needed. Holding public office requires transparency, restraint, and full accountability, especially when taxpayer money is involved.

We, the Filipino people, are entitled to know whether these foreign travels align with public service and national interest. If they do not, steps must be taken to prevent further misuse of government resources.

I urge your office to take this matter seriously and initiate appropriate oversight and legislative inquiry, as necessary.

Respectfully,
William John G. Balderama
Pilipino

Copy furnished to:

The Honorable Ombudsman @ombudsmanph
Office of the Ombudsman
Agham Road, North Triangle, Diliman, Quezon City

The Honorable Chairperson
Commission on Audit
Commonwealth Avenue, Quezon City

The Honorable Comptroller
Office of the Comptroller
